data.body: Epic closure note (save-point 2026-05-23): Epic stays in_progress until all 7 Closure Checks are verified by dso:completion-verifier against live GitHub Actions telemetry. Earliest closable date is ~30 days AFTER PR 7 merges (the rolling 30-day failure-rate window in check #3). Per user directive earlier this session: do not fabricate alert/closure evidence to short-circuit. After PR 7 merges, schedule a +30d wakeup to re-run completion-verifier.
